agenda_text:
TRAFFIC SAFETY COMMITTEE
  MEETING AGENDA
  WEDNESDAY NOVEMBER 19, 2025 9:30 AM
  SAN DIMAS COUNCIL CHAMBER CONFERENCE ROOM
  245 EAST BONITA AVENUE

PLEASE NOTE: Traffic Safety Committee is an Advisory Committee which is open to the public. In order to conduct the
meeting effectively and fairly, participants will be given an opportunity to discuss their concerns within a 3 -minute time
allotment. This timing has been instituted to ensure everyone wishing to speak has the same opportunity. We appreciate
your understanding and cooperation with this policy.

If you have any additional questions, please contact staff at (909) 394-6240 or email at publicworks@sandimasca.gov.

COMMITTEE MEMBERS

Shari Garwick (Director of Public Works), Steve Barragan (Engineering Manager, Public Works Dept.), Esau
Ramos (Manager, Maintenance Yard), Deputy Martinez, (San Dimas Sheriff’s Department), Sergeant Caamal
(San Dimas Sheriff’s Department), Ruben Perales (Traffic Engineer), Rose Lee (BUSD Manager of Special
Assignments), Genevieve Amaro (Management Aide, Public Works Dept.)

INTRODUCTIONS

DISCUSSION ITEMS

11-25-01 Reeder & Renshaw Stop Sign
Request from Resident, to upgrade to LED Stop Sign

11-25-02 812 N Amelia Red Curb Request
Request from Resident, to consider installation of red curb

11-25-03 San Dimas Canyon Road & Gladstone St Stop Sign
Request from LA County, review intersection

11-25-04 Valley Center Rd & Cienega Ave Stop Sign Stop Sign
Request from Resident, to consider installing LED Stop Sign

11-25-05 Baseline Road Speed Limit Concern
Request from Resident, review Baseline Road speed limit from Amelia Avenue to San Dimas Avenue

11-25-06 Bonita Ave Review of Speed Limit Signage
Request from Staff, review westbound speed limit signage along Bonita Ave from Walnut Ave to Pony Express

11-25-07 Holiday Extravaganza
Request from staff, to review TTCP.

CONTINUED ITEMS
 Traffic Safety Committee Agenda
For the Meeting of November 19, 2025  Page 2

05-25-04 &06 Renwick and Shellman Avenue Park Usage & Parking Concerns
Request from residents, review park usage and parking concerns along Shellman Avenue and adjacent streets.

09-25-04 Kelsey Road & Bidwell Road turning onto Bidwell
Request from Resident, to review perceived line of sight concern.

ORAL COMMUNICATIONS

ADJOURNMENT

  Notice Regarding Americans with Disabilities Act: In compliance with the ADA, if you need
  assistance to participate in a city meeting, please contact the City Clerk's Office at (909) 394-
  6216. Early notification before the meeting you wish to attend will make it possible for the City
  to make reasonable arrangements to ensure accessibility to this meeting [28 CFR 35.102-35.104
  ADA Title II].

Copies of documents distributed for the meeting are available in alternative formats upon request. Any writings
or documents provided to the City Council regarding any item on this agenda will be made available for public
review Monday through Thursday 7:30 a.m. to 5:30 p.m. and on Fridays from 7:30 a.m. to 4:30 p.m. at the
Public Works Department. In addition, most documents are posted on the City's website at
www.sandimasca.gov.

Posting Statement: I declare under penalty of perjury that on November 13, 2025, I posted a true and correct
copy of this agenda on the bulletin board in the Civic Center Plaza of City Hall at 245 E. Bonita Ave., and on
the City's website www.sandimasca.gov/agendas-minutes/as required by law.

  Genevieve Amaro
November 13, 2025
  Genevieve Amaro, Management Aide
